$comment: Country pop-up (Welcome Page, Figma 76:196; scope 2.3). ON for UAE visitors only (user decision 2 Oct 2026): Figma has the UAE version only; KSA / other countries wait for Pramod (add an entry under `countries`). Shown only on Global (EN + AR), only on a first visit, only when the visitor's detected country (Cloudflare, functions/_middleware.ts -> ch_geo cookie) has an entry under `countries`. Figma has the UAE version only, so other countries see nothing. Per country: `text` = key in src/data/content/forms/welcome.<locale>.json, `map` / `flag` = image keys under src/assets, `buttons[].target` = the edition region saved in the ch_edition cookie (window.chooseEdition). Targets for AE are an interpretation of the Figma text ('Continue Here' = the UAE website, 'Go to Global Website' = stay on Global): change them here once Pramod confirms. Closing with Esc saves 'global' (the visitor stays where they are) so it is not shown again.
